verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right (logo, can, headline, sale ribbon, CTA), but the can is shrunk to a tiny icon, the legal line sits right under the headline at near-illegible size, and the red ribbon is wedged tight against the CTA. B has a strong headline, but the logo is tiny and crowded by a decorative circle, the tilted sale ribbon is jammed into the bottom-left corner and nearly clipped, and the legal text wraps to three cramped lines under the CTA, running into the bottom edge, so the right side is overstuffed.
